text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Today's outing was super satisfying too!
Now all that's left is to head back to the academy and rest up—"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
Then how the hell are we supposed to turn it around?!
An inn that barely gets any guests at all!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman
text_block_list.text:
Don't go throwing a tantrum right after inheriting it!
It has a long history, so you've got to treat it with care!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Are you having some kind of trouble?
Let's ask her!"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I'm thinking of closing down
my parents' inn. It's got history, sure,
but it's run-down and no guests come anyway...”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
With fewer and fewer guests, the inn has no choice but to close down...
The precious place inherited from my parents...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Um!! Please show me that inn once!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is the entrance hall...
............

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You're right! That's disgusting!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Because the entryway is where you welcome the gods of fortune, you know!? We can't welcome them like this!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the cardinal direction isn't bad!
There's plenty of potential to bring in good fortune!
Let's turn things around with feng shui!”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's give it our all, Trainer!
Roll up your sleeves! Put on your work gloves too~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's sweep away the dust and bad vibes♪
Swish-swish, flick-flick, out they go♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the floor's original color is finally showing through!
Hello there, feeling good? Finally getting a chance to breathe?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Considering the "protrusions and recesses"...
Alright, let's move that chest of drawers too!
And that vanity mirror over there! Plus this, and that—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
To get the good energy flowing, we've gotta go all out☆
Fight, fight!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's go shopping when this is done!
We've gotta change up the knick-knacks in your room too~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, the floor creaks when you walk on it...
Might need to drive a few screws in?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, Papa? Hey, can you call over a craftsman?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Since we're here, let's do it!
It'd be so sad to leave the hallway crying!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, her cleaning plan—powered by feng shui and sheer brute force—steadily progressed—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew, what do you think?
Doesn't it look much cleaner?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
I'm amazed...
That inn used to be so gloomy!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it feels so wonderful!
Like I've been reborn...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I only cleaned your room for you!
Plus, I adjusted a few things for feng shui, so you're gonna get happier and happier from now on!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Happy buildings☆, lucky old folks☆
See? Wouldn't that be simply wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Yeah, that's right!
After having it restored so beautifully,
I can't let it end with my generation!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
This precious inn passed down through generations—
I'll turn over a new leaf and do my best to revive it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You're welcome!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to energize everyone with feng shui!
For that, I can work as hard as it takes!
choice_data_list: You could put the pros to shame!
All that hard work... it was worth it...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I've been watching and learning from Dad ever since I was little!
I'm so glad I could be of help!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, a pro... a pro, huh!
Hehehe, that has such a nice ring to it! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It may have seemed a bit forceful, but her powerful demeanor brought
happiness to people. I hoped she would continue to freely
demonstrate her full power going forward.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did you get tired out!?
Sorry, sorry!
choice_data_list: Still, it's a pleasant kind of tiredness.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...! Wonderful!
Same here!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tired after doing a good deed—it feels amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It may have seemed a bit forceful, but her powerful demeanor brought
happiness to people. I hoped she would continue to freely
demonstrate her full power going forward.
